title: A Happy E-mail Brings Sadness
notes: Recurring detective-cast nodes (Conan, Kogoro Mouri, Ran) omitted by convention. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. Two-layer mystery: Migita commits an attempted murder (strangles Nana believing he has killed her, then fakes an alibi by briefly disabling his shop's surveillance cameras) that the old low-fidelity case file mistook for the completed murder; the real, fatal act is a second strangling committed shortly after by Samon, who had engineered the whole setup (sent fake harassing messages to Migita from Nana's phone to provoke the attack, then finished her off and staged a dying message pointing at Migita using her hand). The old `cases/` file names Migita (s2) as sole murderer and invents a rope as murder weapon -- neither is supported by the transcript: no rope appears (she is strangled by hand each time), and Migita's strangling is the attempted, not completed, murder. Corrected here: murderer_id is Samon (p2); Migita is a suspect/attempted-murderer only. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: Stroke order of the dying message's kanji matches only the order Samon (a teacher) demonstrates for 'migi', not the order Migita writes it in -- proves Samon, not Migita or Nana, wrote the message.
Nana's genuine e-mails never use punctuation and always sign 'Nana'; the e-mails that enraged Migita use punctuation and drop the signature -- proves those weren't written by Nana.
A TV news report timestamps a nearby car crash at 10:30, but the bookshop's surveillance footage shows no reaction to the noise -- reveals that segment of footage is missing, not continuous.
Migita's hair is messy right before he drops out of camera view and neatly flattened, helmet-like, when he reappears -- reveals he left the shop and rode somewhere in between.
Gunshot residue on Nana's strangled body matches residue from the party poppers pulled at Samon's in-class celebration that day, contradicting his claim of never having met her.
